messages:
maria: CI red on feature/arm-image — build finishes but push step fails in Buildkite. Error is 'unexpected EOF reading trailer' from our registry. Happening on the arm builder only. Job: https://buildkite.example/teams/infra/pipelines/images/builds/1234
ci-bot: buildkite: Job #1234 finished: fail — see logs above
kevin: can you paste the exact docker/podman output? is it consistently ARM only?
maria: snippet: ```Step 14/16 : PUSH image -> registry.redwood.internal/myorg/feature-arm:sha-abc123
writing manifest to image destination
error storing blob: unexpected EOF reading trailer
error: failed to push some layers```
jen: hmm I've seen that when a proxy/nginx in front of the registry mangles chunked responses. Did we just rotate the nginx certs or change proxy settings?
sam: also sometimes buildkit's parallel uploads expose flaky backends. Workaround: try `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` or set `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0` to disable chunked uploads.
maria: okay trying a rerun with `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` in the pipeline step, will report back
registry-bot: registry logs (nginx front): ```2026/03/17 09:11:02 [error] 1234#0: *567 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.4, server: registry.redwood.internal, request: "PUT /v2/myorg/feature-arm/blobs/uploads/uuid HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.4.5:5000/uuid", host: "registry.redwood.internal"```
kevin: that upstream prematurely closed connection + trailer EOF aligns. Any recent change to keepalive/timeouts or to nginx proxy_buffering?
jen: I checked infra diffs — we disabled chunked transfer buffering on one proxy host during cert rotation (merge by infra: infra/ops#842). That could do it. Nginx will pass chunked uploads differently depending on proxy settings.
sam: short-lived workaround: use `skopeo copy` from the builder to push, it uses single-threaded uploads by default. Or set `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` on docker/podman. Longer term, we should fix the proxy config to not drop upstream connections mid-upload.
maria: rerun finished — with `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` push succeeded. Putting a temp change in pipeline for arm builders. Filing INF ticket: INF-456 with logs and nginx diff. Tagging infra.
kevin: nice. Can infra revert that proxy tweak or adjust `proxy_read_timeout`/`proxy_send_timeout`?
jen: filing a follow-up with ops: PR opened (infra/ops#847) to set `proxy_request_buffering on; proxy_read_timeout 120s; proxy_send_timeout 120s` and remove the accidental chunked_disable.
maria: thanks all — leaving the pipeline change in place until ops confirms rollback. cc @sam for cleanup plan to revert `--max-concurrent-uploads` after infra fix :thumbsup:
sam: got it, will watch INF-456 and remove the change after ops deploys.
ci-bot: buildkite: rerun #1235 succeeded :white_check_mark:
